correctness.rationale: For A_d=k[x_1,...,x_d]/(x_i²), squarefree monomials span dimension 2^d and automorphisms are precisely substitutions invertible on m/m². In characteristic 2, each generator image a_i+Σ_j L_{ji}x_j+Σ_|S|>=2 c_{Si}x_S squares to a_i². The universal finite-type automorphism scheme is therefore cut out only by a_i²=0 and det L invertible, a scheme product alpha_2^d×GL_d×A^{d(2^d-d-1)} (no group-product assertion). The reduced variety has dimension d(2^d-1) while Der_k(A_d) has dimension d2^d, an exact excess of d. In other characteristic, comparing distinct x_rx_s coefficients forces monomial cotangent columns; for each f_i=x_{sigma(i)}u_i+v_i, f_i²=0 and 2u_i invertible force v_i=0. Each of d! strata has d units of a (d-1)-variable squarefree ring, giving d!(q-1)^d q^{d(2^{d-1}-1)} and smoothness by tangent dimension. Independently exhausted all square-zero generator pairs and invertible linear maps for d=2, q=2,3, recovering 24 and 72 automorphisms and tangent dimensions 8 and 4.
